items.title: Andrea Bajcsy awarded 2026 Packard Fellowship for Science and Engineering
items.summary_en: CMU Robotics Institute assistant professor Andrea Bajcsy is one of 20 researchers named 2026 Packard Fellows. The award provides about $985,834 in unrestricted funding over five years. Her work focuses on safer, more reliable robots.
items.notes: Award announcement, not a research result. Details from a search snippet; RI page not fetched.

items.title: Andrea Bajcsy named 2026 AI2050 Early Career Fellow (Schmidt Sciences)
items.summary_en: Bajcsy was named a 2026 AI2050 Early Career Fellow, a program sponsored by Schmidt Sciences that aims to make AI safer. The program reportedly provides up to $16 million over three years to the cohort. CMU SCS says three of its faculty were named fellows.
items.source_name: CMU School of Computer Science News
items.notes: Award announcement. Date from RI news listing via search; page not opened.

items.title: CMU robotics expertise and facilities draw IROS 2026 attendees
items.summary_en: Hundreds of robotics academics and industry leaders toured CMU robotics and engineering facilities on Oct. 1, during IROS, which returned to Pittsburgh for the first time since 1995.
items.notes: Likely before the 2026-10-10 window; context only, orchestrator may drop.
